cues: Inverse tan of y over x cannot tell minus one minus i from one plus i: it gives the same angle.
So find the acute angle alpha first, then fix the quadrant from the picture.
text: The calculator trap. Inverse tan of y over x cannot tell minus one minus i from one plus i: it gives the same angle. So find the acute angle alpha first, then fix the quadrant from the picture. Second quadrant: pi minus alpha. Third: minus, pi minus alpha. Fourth: minus alpha.
